x: There have been some superb world sprinters in the last decade – Burrell, Lewis, Fredericks, Christie, Bailey, etc. – and the current crop is tremendous – Ato Boldon, Maurice Greene – but none of them have run faster than the Belgrave boy at 19 years of age.

Darren reached the semi-final stage but Dwain went all the way to the final shoot-out with Maurice Greene & Co. The Tommy Green Cup for most oustanding performance by a Belgrave male athlete in 1999 goes to the man who improved to 9.97 seconds for the 100 metres to take the World Championships bronz…
But those five included his clubmate Chambers, USA's World Record holder Maurice Greene and Tim Montgomery, and Kareem Streete-Thompson of the Cayman Isles.
